note: Adjudicated punctuation variants among the three transcribed witnesses. Their spoken words agree; the selected punctuation and individual differences are recorded below.

adjudicated.ruling: The selected full stop presents Orémus as a separate invitation, following handmissal-eo. DO prints a comma before an inline parenthetical rubric. Here the rubric occupies its own segment.
The page sets Orémus inside the rubric that runs on, with a comma. The edition prints it as its own line, with a full stop.
No comma after Christum, following MR and handmissal-eo. Dóminum nostrum stands in apposition to Christum. DO inserts a comma at this point.
The comma after sunt follows MR and DO and closes the relative clause quorum relíquiæ hic sunt. Mérita governs both Sanctórum tuórum and ómnium Sanctórum. Handmissal-eo omits this comma.
